literal: By kin to be surrounded living, wealth indeed by the acquiring obtained fruit.
translation: Living surrounded by one's kin is the true fruit gained by acquiring wealth.
modern: ஒருவன் தன் சுற்றத்தார் தன்னைச் சுற்றி அன்போடு இருக்கும்படி வாழ்வதுதான், அவன் செல்வத்தைப் பெற்றதனால் அடைந்த உண்மையான பயனாகும்.
explanation: This couplet defines the ultimate purpose of acquiring wealth. It states that the true benefit of earning riches is the ability to live surrounded by loving relatives. Wealth is not meant to be hoarded but used to support and embrace one's kin, ensuring they remain close. The word 'சுற்றத்தால்' emphasizes the presence of family, while 'பெற்ற பயன்' highlights that this togetherness is the very fruit of prosperity.
